title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Lead Test Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


Key responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a deep, system-level understanding of the entire product architecture to ensure comprehensive and thorough testing across all layers.
  • Proactively identify, coordinate, and manage cross-team dependencies to ensure seamless end-to-end quality and delivery.
  • Employ extensive testing experience across Native Mobile Applications, Backend services, and Front-end systems .
  • Design and execute advanced testing techniques, including thorough Monkey Testing , and champion the introduction of Chaos Engineering practices into the development pipeline.
  • Identify tasks/dependencies/risks during backlog grooming/planning.
  • Provide reasonable test estimates and feedback on priorities.
  • Fully understand and actively provide ways to improve project/solution level test strategy/test design principles.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of testing tools/techniques/strategies.
  • Contribute effectively to the development of a project's test strategy and automation suite.
  • Collaborate with developers/business analysts for feedback into software design and tests.
  • Assist with effective test reporting and contribute to ensuring the CI/CD pipeline has thorough test coverages.
  • Contribute effectively to utilize an automation framework for testing and the creation of test scripts (different automation test layers such as UI or API Acceptance Tests).
  • Identify gaps in the current automation suite and help prioritize those / get them into the backlog.
  • Investigate and assist in diagnosing issues.
  • Share testing/product knowledge with other team members.

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Quality Assurance or Software Testing, with a focus on large, complex, and distributed systems.
  • Proven experience as a coordinator or leader managing QA activities across multiple, interdependent teams and technical domains (Mobile, Web, Backend).
  • Deep expertise in various testing methodologies, including mandatory experience with Monkey Testing and/or a strong theoretical or practical background in Chaos Engineering/Resilience Testing.
  • Mandatory professional experience testing: Native Mobile Applications (iOS and/or Android), Distributed Backend/Microservices Platforms.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, preferably AWS, and understanding of how cloud services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) impact system testing.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience in complex frontend web applications.
  • Automation is a plus; experience programming or scripting in at least one modern language (e.g., Python or Ruby).


What we offer

  • 100% remote in Poland, Romania, Ukraine, or Brazil.
  • B2B Contract.
  • English classes.

title: Backend Data Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a strong Backend Engineer who thrives in fast-moving environments and has a specialty in all things data. They are at an inflection point. Their product is live and working, customers are telling them what they need, and the engineering team is building rapidly.


You will work deep in complex backend systems and will be their go-to person for everything data-related: ingestion, modeling, pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps it all running. This is not a data-first role that happens to touch the backend; it is a backend role where data mastery is your distinguishing edge.


What you'll do:

  • Design, build, optimize and maintain scalable features and systems across our Python/Django backend
  • Design and build robust data ingestion pipelines to onboard, normalize, and continuously update third-party data sources that power our platform
  • Own data modeling and schema design across our platform, ensuring our data layer is structured for performance, flexibility, and long-term scale
  • Implement asynchronous and distributed processing to handle large-scale operations reliably and efficiently
  • Own data infrastructure tooling - including pipeline orchestration, storage, and warehousing - alongside application-layer development
  • Contribute to new product capabilities and integrations, working closely with other developers, AI engineers and data scientists
  • Collaborate directly with the CTO to define data strategy and technical architecture as the platform scales


What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex backend systems in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python and Django (or a comparable framework)
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows
  • Deep understanding of data modeling and database schema design for both relational and non-relational systems
  • Hands-on experience with data infrastructure tooling, including orchestration, storage, and warehousing
  • Solid command of asynchronous programming and distributed systems concepts
  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs
  • Comfort operating in small, fast-moving teams with limited oversight
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset


Bonus points for:

  • Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Previous work supporting ML, AI, or agentic systems
  • Experience with the Django REST framework
  • Understanding of Terraform or cloud infrastructure as code
  • Experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, or regulated data environments


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing company at a pivotal stage, shaping scalable data-driven systems and architecture.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.


What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu products membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. title: Paralegal Junior
description:
A Cunha Law PLLC é um escritório de advocacia americano sediado em Washington, DC, dedicado ao direito de imigração e negócios, com forte atuação em imigração de negócios e atendimento à comunidade brasileira nos Estados Unidos e no exterior. Assessoramos empresas, investidores, executivos e profissionais qualificados em toda a gama de matérias da área — vistos de trabalho (H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN), vistos de investidor (E-2, EB-5), residência permanente baseada em emprego (EB-1, EB-2, NIW, PERM), abertura e estruturação de empresas nos EUA, além de petições familiares, naturalização e atuação contenciosa. Operamos com o padrão técnico de um escritório de primeira linha e o suporte de uma estrutura moderna, orientada por tecnologia e processos.

Não somos uma consultoria de imigração e não competimos com despachantes.  Esse posicionamento define tudo o que fazemos. O mercado brasileiro de imigração americana é dominado por intermediários que preenchem formulários, repassam o trabalho técnico para terceiros e cobram por volume — e é exatamente isso que não somos.

Estamos contratando um(a) paralegal de imigração para assumir uma carteira ativa de casos. Você será responsável por conduzir os casos do início ao fim, em coordenação com o restante do time.



Nossa Cultura — Leia com Atenção Antes de se Candidatar

Na Cunha Law, cultura não é slogan de parede — é o critério pelo qual contratamos, avaliamos e decidimos quem permanece no time. Nossos clientes são empresas e profissionais que tomam decisões estratégicas a partir do nosso trabalho: contratações internacionais, expansões para os Estados Unidos, mudanças de país, investimentos de capital, transferências de executivos. Quando um cliente nos contrata, ele está colocando nas nossas mãos não apenas um processo administrativo, mas o cronograma de um negócio, a continuidade de uma carreira, a estabilidade de uma família. Para nós, todo dia é o dia mais importante da vida de um cliente  — e por isso tratamos cada formulário, cada prazo e cada e-mail com a seriedade que o futuro de um negócio ou de uma carreira exige. Não existe caso \"pequeno\" aqui: existe o caso de alguém, e ele merece o mesmo nível de cuidado técnico que daríamos ao caso mais complexo do escritório.


E, acima de tudo, contratamos por talento, não por pedigree. Damos chances reais a profissionais que escritórios maiores ignoram — pessoas vindas de cidades pequenas, de faculdades sem nome de marca, de trajetórias menos lineares — porque acreditamos que o talento está distribuído de forma muito mais ampla do que as oportunidades. Mas o nível é alto e ele não baixa. Não estamos construindo um \"escritório bom para o tamanho que tem\"; estamos construindo um escritório que entrega no nível dos melhores da área, e quem entra no time entra para esse padrão. Se você quer um lugar que vai investir em você de verdade — em treinamento, em ferramentas, em mentoria — e que vai cobrar muito em troca, você vai se encaixar aqui. Se você procura um lugar confortável onde o esforço médio é suficiente, este não é o lugar.

Responsabilidades
  • Condução completa de casos de imigração , do intake ao deferimento, garantindo que cada etapa avance dentro do prazo e com qualidade;
  • Atendimento direto ao cliente  em português e inglês — escuta ativa, comunicação clara, empatia e resposta rápida;
  • Entrevistas de intake  e elaboração de questionários, identificando elegibilidade, riscos e documentação necessária;
  • Coleta, análise crítica e organização de documentos  apresentados pelo cliente, identificando inconsistências e solicitando complementações quando necessário;
  • Preparação de formulários USCIS  e montagem de pacotes prontos para protocolo, com índice de exhibits e cartas de apresentação;
  • Redação de cartas de apoio, declarações e memorandos  em inglês jurídico claro e bem fundamentado;
  • Pesquisa jurídica preliminar  sobre questões processuais e substantivas de imigração;
  • Suporte na elaboração de respostas a RFEs  (Requests for Evidence) e NOIDs;
  • Gestão completa da carteira no Zoho CRM e Zoho Projects  — anotações limpas, status sempre atualizado, prazos visíveis, sem pontas soltas;
  • Organização de arquivos no Drive , mantendo a estrutura padrão do escritório;
  • Controle rigoroso de prazos USCIS  — recibos, biometria, RFEs, entrevistas, validade de documentos;
  • Acompanhamento proativo do andamento dos casos  junto ao USCIS e atualização periódica do cliente, mesmo quando não há novidades;
  • Coordenação com terceiros  — empregadores, escolas, médicos, tradutores e consulados — para obtenção de documentação;
  • Apontamento diário de horas e notas de billing
  • Submissão do trabalho para revisão jurídica  antes de qualquer protocolo;
  • Identificação de oportunidades de supreender o cleinte (awesomeness)  em cada caso



Requirements REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS
  • Bacharelado
  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência  em direito de imigração americano, atendimento a clientes internacionais, ou área jurídica correlata
Tem menos de 1 ano de experiência mas acredita que tem o perfil certo? Candidate-se mesmo assim. Valorizamos talento e disposição para aprender, e estamos sempre dispostos a conhecer profissionais promissores.
  • Inglês fluente — escrito e falado  (essencial e não-negociável; você vai redigir documentos jurídicos, ler legislação americana e atender clientes em inglês todos os dias)
  • Português nativo
  • Espanhol  é um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horário comercial dos Estados Unidos  (fuso de Washington, DC) e seguir o calendário americano de feriados
  • Disponibilidade para emitir nota fiscal como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Estrutura de home office adequada — internet estável, computador, ambiente silencioso
  • Organização rigorosa e atenção a detalhes  — capacidade de gerenciar dezenas de casos ativos sem perder prazos
  • Conforto com tecnologia — disposição para aprender novas ferramentas rapidamente
Diferenciais (Preferenciais)
  • Advogado(a) inscrito(a) na OAB
  • Espanhol  (escrito e falado) — atendemos também clientes hispanofalantes
  • Experiência prévia em escritório de advocacia de imigração americana
  • Experiência com a plataforma Zoho  (CRM, Projects, WorkDrive)
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Direito Internacional, Direito Americano ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência internacional ou experiência prévia atendendo público nos EUA



Benefits
  • Contrato PJ, pagamento mensal em reais
  • 100% remoto a partir do Brasil
  • Curso de aperfeiçoamento de inglês custeado pelo escritório  — investimos no contínuo desenvolvimento do seu inglês jurídico e profissional
  • Carteira de casos própria e bem definida — você sabe exatamente o que é seu
  • Stack moderno de tecnologia — nada de papel, nada de caos
  • Treinamento estruturado em direito de imigração americano
  • Espaço real de crescimento para casos mais complexos conforme você demonstra domínio
  • Trabalho com propósito, em uma área que muda a vida das pessoas

title: Analista de Dados Digitais (Tracking & Analytics)
description:
Sobre a THREAD


A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.


Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, conectando estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.


Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores, entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que unem tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.

Buscamos um Analista de Dados Digitais (Tracking & Analytics) para atuar 100% remoto, apoiando a estruturação, coleta e análise de dados em produtos digitais de clientes.


Você será responsável por garantir que os dados capturados reflitam corretamente o comportamento do usuário, apoiando decisões de produto, marketing e negócio.


Esperamos alguém organizado, analítico e com forte capacidade de execução, que consiga transformar necessidades de negócio em estruturas de tracking claras, confiáveis e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades


  • Estruturar e manter mapas de tags (tracking plan)

  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na criação e validação de variáveis e eventos
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados coletados

  • Validar implementações de tracking (debug, testes e QA)
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times técnicos e de produto para entender necessidades de mensuração
  • Documentar regras de tracking e estrutura de eventos
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na coleta e uso de dados


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics (GA4)
  • Conhecimento em estruturação de tracking (eventos, variáveis, dataLayer)
  • Experiência com Looker Studio (criação de dashboards)
  • Capacidade de estruturar mapas de mensuração (tracking plan)
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times técnicos (devs)
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Capacidade de validar e garantir qualidade dos dados


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Qlik
  • Noções de HTML/CSS/JavaScript
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Hotjar, Firebase, etc.
  • Conhecimento em funil de conversão e métricas digitais
  • Experiência com testes A/B
  • Vivência em produtos digitais ou squads de tecnologia


Mindset esperado


  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade com dados e entregas
  • Organização e disciplina operacional
  • Autonomia para executar e destravar demandas
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com times técnicos
  • Foco em qualidade e confiabilidade da informação
  • Mentalidade analítica e orientada a impacto

title: Firewall Engineer
description:
We’re Hiring: Firewall Engineer (L3 Support – F5 Technologies)


We are looking for a skilled Firewall Engineer to provide L3-level support from a nearshore location in Latin America, with a strong focus on F5 technologies . This role involves operational support, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of F5 devices and related security infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities

• Manage and support F5 BIG-IP platforms (LTM, GTM/DNS, ASM, APM as applicable)

• Perform L3 troubleshooting for application delivery, load balancing, and firewall-related issues

• Implement configuration changes, policy updates, and SSL certificate management

• Analyze traffic flows and security events to ensure optimal performance and protection

• Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis for F5-related issues

• Support automation or scripting tasks for configuration consistency (e.g., Python, iControl REST)

• Maintain documentation for configurations, standards, and operational procedures

• Collaborate with network and security teams to support enterprise-wide initiatives


✅ Required Skills

• Strong hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP modules

• Deep understanding of L4–L7 traffic flows, TCP/IP, and application delivery

• Ability to troubleshoot complex issues independently at an L3 level

• Experience working in remote/nearshore support models


If you’re ready to take on complex challenges in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you!

title: \"Aplication Change Management System Engineer #1001025\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade .

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes relacionados a mudanças, além de apoiar times globais na coordenação de atividades e agendamentos.
  • Realizar comunicação constante com stakeholders técnicos e funcionais em diferentes regiões.
  • Participar de atividades de melhoria contínua, Disaster Recovery e suporte on-call em regime global.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com processos de Change Management em ambientes SAP
  • Conhecimento em SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, Focused Build e STMS
  • Capacidade analítica e forte habilidade na resolução de problemas
  • Perfil organizado, proativo e orientado a processos e prazos
  • Habilidade de comunicação com times globais e múltiplos stakeholders
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente ágil e sob pressão
  • Conhecimento em gestão de múltiplos ambientes SAP e transport layers
  • Disponibilidade para suporte on-call e atuação em janelas globais


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência em ambientes SAP

  • Conhecimento em ITIL e práticas de gestão de mudanças
  • Experiência com Disaster Recovery e ambientes críticos
  • Participação em times Agile globais

Onde você vai trabalhar?

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
Sobre a vaga

O(a) Partner Success Manager atuará em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e organizações parceiras de serviços para assegurar resultados de alta qualidade. Trata-se de uma excelente oportunidade para ajudar a definir e expandir uma função que impacta diretamente o desempenho das entregas, ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve a capacidade de longo prazo dos parceiros.


Principais responsabilidades

• Garantir que os parceiros entreguem valor mensurável e dentro do prazo aos clientes, tanto na implementação quanto ao longo da jornada do cliente.

• Manter visibilidade sobre o progresso das implementações dos parceiros, atuando de forma transversal para acelerar entregas e assegurar o cumprimento de marcos.

• Identificar riscos de forma proativa, reduzir fricções e gerenciar escalonamentos, facilitando planos de recuperação (“path to green”) e engajando as partes envolvidas para resolução de problemas.

• Garantir que os escalonamentos sejam monitorados, tratados com urgência e reportados de forma adequada.

• Colaborar com a área de Enablement para avaliar a prontidão e o alinhamento dos parceiros.

• Impulsionar o desenvolvimento de capacidades dos parceiros por meio de atividades estruturadas de capacitação e oportunidades de shadowing.

• Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Delivery, Suporte, Produto e Cloud para otimizar o suporte às implementações.

• Capturar e reportar resultados de entrega, tendências de escalonamento e indicadores de prontidão.

• Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de playbooks, procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) e frameworks de sucesso de parceiros.


Qualificações essenciais

• Mais de 2 anos de experiência em suporte à entrega, operações com parceiros, customer success, coordenação de projetos ou áreas correlatas.

• Forte organização e atenção aos detalhes.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.

• Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes multifuncionais.


Desejáveis

• Experiência com ferramentas de acompanhamento de projetos ou tickets (ex.: Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk).

• Vivência com programas de ecossistema de parceiros ou governança de entregas.

• Proficiência em idiomas conforme a região (ver variações regionais).

title: Consultor de Infraestrutura Sênior
description:
Consultor Sênior de Imagens de Sistemas Operacionais  


Objetivo da posição  


Atuar na criação, hardening, empacotamento e distribuição de Golden Images corporativas, incluindo a geração de ISOs bootáveis para instalação em computadores físicos (bare-metal), garantindo padronização, segurança, reprodutibilidade e escalabilidade global. 



Principais responsabilidades  


  • Criar e manter Golden Images para ambientes Windows e Linux a partir de instalações limpas 
  • Aplicar patches, atualizações e configurações padrão, garantindo baseline técnico e controle de versões 
  • Realizar hardening de sistemas com base em CIS Benchmark (nível 1) 
  • Gerar e validar ISOs bootáveis (bare-metal) para instalação em hardware físico 
  • Garantir compatibilidade com BIOS/UEFI, drivers essenciais e diferentes tipos de hardware 
  • Validar instalações em cenários online e offline (ou com baixa dependência de rede) 
  • Instalar, configurar e validar agentes corporativos (ex: Qualys, Tanium, Defender/CrowdStrike, Zabbix) 
  • Realizar testes de boot físico e virtual, validações funcionais e de performance 
  • Apoiar a distribuição global de imagens (ex: SFTP ou repositórios seguros) 
  • Identificar, analisar e remediar vulnerabilidades (ex: Qualys), assegurando imagens “security-ready” 
  • Produzir documentação técnica completa (runbooks, procedimentos, evidências para auditoria) 
  • Atuar em processos de governança e mudanças (Change, GMUD, CAB) 



Requisitos  


  • Inglês Fluente 
  • Experiência com criação e manutenção de Golden Images (Windows e Linux) 
  • Conhecimento em Windows Server 2022 (ou superior), SYSPREP e criação de mídia bootável 
  • Experiência com Linux (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS ou similar), incluindo boot, initramfs e systemd 
  • Conhecimento em geração e validação de ISO bootável e instalações bare-metal 
  • Entendimento de conceitos de boot (BIOS vs UEFI) e validação em hardware físico 
  • Experiência com práticas de hardening e segurança, incluindo CIS Benchmark 
  • Conhecimento em gestão de vulnerabilidades (CVE, análise de risco e remediação) 
  • Experiência com instalação e validação de agentes de segurança e monitoramento 
  • Capacidade de atuar com testes técnicos, validações e troubleshooting em nível L2/L3 
  • Experiência em documentação técnica e processos de governança 



Diferenciais  


  • Experiência com ambientes virtualizados (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V) 
  • Vivência em ambientes híbridos (on-premise e cloud) 
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento 
  • Experiência com automação (scripts para build e configuração de imagens) 
  • Vivência em ambientes globais 
  • Conhecimento em ITIL / ITSM 


Informações adicionais: 


  • Regime de contratação: CLT 
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

title: Client Services Representative
description:
Sobre a Cunha Law PLLC

A Cunha Law PLLC é um escritório de advocacia americano sediado em Washington, DC, dedicado ao direito de imigração e negócios, com forte atuação em imigração de negócios e atendimento à comunidade brasileira nos Estados Unidos e no exterior. Assessoramos empresas, investidores, executivos e profissionais qualificados em toda a gama de matérias da área — vistos de trabalho (H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN), vistos de investidor (E-2, EB-5), residência permanente baseada em emprego (EB-1, EB-2, NIW, PERM), abertura e estruturação de empresas nos EUA, além de petições familiares, naturalização e atuação contenciosa. Operamos com o padrão técnico de um escritório de primeira linha e o suporte de uma estrutura moderna, orientada por tecnologia e processos.

Não somos uma consultoria de imigração e não competimos com despachantes.  Esse posicionamento define tudo o que fazemos. O mercado brasileiro de imigração americana é dominado por intermediários que preenchem formulários, repassam o trabalho técnico para terceiros e cobram por volume — e é exatamente isso que não somos.



Nossa Cultura — Leia com Atenção Antes de se Candidatar

Na Cunha Law, cultura não é slogan de parede — é o critério pelo qual contratamos, avaliamos e decidimos quem permanece no time. Nossos clientes são empresas e profissionais que tomam decisões estratégicas a partir do nosso trabalho: contratações internacionais, expansões para os Estados Unidos, mudanças de país, investimentos de capital, transferências de executivos. Quando um cliente nos contrata, ele está colocando nas nossas mãos não apenas um processo administrativo, mas o cronograma de um negócio, a continuidade de uma carreira, a estabilidade de uma família. Para nós, todo dia é o dia mais importante da vida de um cliente  — e por isso tratamos cada formulário, cada prazo e cada e-mail com a seriedade que o futuro de um negócio ou de uma carreira exige. Não existe caso \"pequeno\" aqui: existe o caso de alguém, e ele merece o mesmo nível de cuidado técnico que daríamos ao caso mais complexo do escritório.


E, acima de tudo, contratamos por talento, não por pedigree. Damos chances reais a profissionais que escritórios maiores ignoram — pessoas vindas de cidades pequenas, de faculdades sem nome de marca, de trajetórias menos lineares — porque acreditamos que o talento está distribuído de forma muito mais ampla do que as oportunidades. Mas o nível é alto e ele não baixa. Não estamos construindo um \"escritório bom para o tamanho que tem\"; estamos construindo um escritório que entrega no nível dos melhores da área, e quem entra no time entra para esse padrão. Se você quer um lugar que vai investir em você de verdade — em treinamento, em ferramentas, em mentoria — e que vai cobrar muito em troca, você vai se encaixar aqui. Se você procura um lugar confortável onde o esforço médio é suficiente, este não é o lugar.


obre a Vaga

Estamos contratando um(a) profissional de recepção e atendimento comercial  para ser o primeiro ponto de contato do escritório com novos clientes. Você é a porta de entrada da Cunha Law: a voz no telefone, a resposta no WhatsApp, o e-mail de boas-vindas. Sua missão é receber cada lead com excelência, qualificar a oportunidade, agendar a consulta com o advogado e acompanhar o cliente até a assinatura do contrato.

Responsabilidades
  • Atendimento de leads em todos os canais  — telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail, formulários do site, redes sociais — com resposta rápida, postura profissional e acolhimento
  • Qualificação de leads  — entender a situação do cliente, identificar o tipo de visto ou serviço aplicável, e direcionar corretamente

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Position Overview:

As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‑generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‑first operations, and AI‑driven decision‑making across the organization.


You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.


Responsibilities:

  • Administers day‑to‑day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
  • Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
  • Partners with cross‑functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
  • Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
  • Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
  • Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‑powered workflow automations.
  • Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‑channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
  • Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
  • Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
  • Ensures secure, least‑privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
  • Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
  • Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
  • Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
  • Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‑scaling teams.
  • Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‑to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance.


Position Requirements:

  • 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‑level or high‑velocity environment.
  • Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
  • Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel.


Additional Requirements:

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
  • Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
  • Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
  • Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‑functional GTM operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
  • Hands‑on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment.

Operational Support:

Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.

Familiarity with booking or practice management systems

title: Endpoint System Engineer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Endpoint System Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Endpoint Systems Engineer is responsible for managing and supporting endpoint platforms and tooling across customer environments within the Managed Services organization. This role focuses on endpoint management, patching, monitoring, and automation using centralized management tools. Endpoint Systems Engineers ensure endpoint health, compliance, and performance through proactive monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of tooling and processes.This role combines technical troubleshooting with platform ownership and automation, working closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders to maintain stable, secure, and well-managed endpoint environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Own the health, performance, and compliance of endpoint environments across customer environments.
  • Manage and maintain endpoint management platforms (MDM/RMM), including Intune and NinjaOne.
  • Monitor and maintain endpoint health, patching, and compliance, ensuring successful deployment and remediation of OS and application updates.
  • Investigate and resolve endpoint-related issues, including performance, configuration, and policy enforcement problems.
  • Create and manage problem investigations for recurring or complex endpoint issues.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scripts and automation (PowerShell preferred) to support endpoint management and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain integrations between endpoint management tools and other systems (e.g., ITSM, monitoring platforms).
  • Collaborate with infrastructure and support teams to resolve cross-system issues impacting endpoints.
  • Maintain endpoint configuration standards, policies, and documentation.
  • Participate in change management processes for endpoint-related updates and deployments.
  • Identify and implement improvements to endpoint management, automation, and operational processes.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting endpoint management in an MSP, enterprise IT, or similar environment.
  • Experience with endpoint management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, other MDM solutions).
  • Experience with RMM tools (e.g., NinjaOne or similar platforms).
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID device management.
  • Experience with Windows endpoint administration and lifecycle management.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills related to endpoint systems.
  • Experience with patch management processes and tools.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and structured support processes.
  • Strong scripting skills (PowerShell preferred) for automation and tooling.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Certifications such as Microsoft, endpoint management, or cloud certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Deep experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies, including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.

  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.

Isso inclui definir objetivos de qualidade, apoiar a automação de testes quando apropriado e garantir que as equipes compreendam claramente os processos de teste, controles e expectativas de governança.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems

  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Senior Digital Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Description

In 1995, Acronym created a digital marketing revolution by innovating a futuristic model of the marketing agency. Since then, we’ve forged a lasting path of success helping our Clients achieve their business goals.

Acronym. Our name signifies our deep understanding of both our Clients’ and industries lexicon. We are headquartered in the iconic Empire State Building, with a presence across EMEA and APAC.


Role Description

The Remote Senior Digital Analytics Engineer will join our Analytics & Optimization team. This team member will be instrumental in implementing and maintaining sophisticated digital analytics solutions for our clients, ensuring a robust data foundation that drives strategic business decisions. You will leverage your deep technical expertise and understanding of business objectives to guide clients on best practices and implement cutting-edge tracking strategies. This role will also have the opportunity to explore and implement emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools, to enhance data collection and efficiency over time. Some of the solutions this team member will be working with on a regular basis include Adobe Launch, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Tealium iQ. 


This is the job…


·      Providing strategic guidance on data collection architecture and implementation strategies for web, app, and marketing technology solutions, acting as a technical leader on client engagements. 

·      Ensuring that all data collection and implementation efforts are aligned with client business objectives and contribute to the delivery of accurate and actionable insights that drive measurable results.

·      Working directly with technical stakeholders to answer questions, and help troubleshoot issues.

·      Creating technical documentation for our clients on how to best implement various web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics, as well as other marketing technologies.

·      Expertly configuring tag management systems (e.g., Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ), analytics platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics) and various third-party tracking pixels (Meta, LinkedIn, etc) based on sound data collection principles and industry best practices, as part of a comprehensive data collection strategy.

·      Providing Quality Assurance (QA) of technical stakeholder deployments while thinking ahead on how to build solutions that solve common problems increasing efficiencies and improving data quality.

·      Implementing and maintaining server-side tracking solutions to enhance data accuracy, improve user privacy, and overcome browser limitations.

·      Integrating analytics platforms with other marketing and business systems (e.g., CRM, advertising platforms) using APIs to create a unified view of customer data.

·      Optimizing analytics implementations for website and application performance to ensure tracking does not negatively impact user experience.


This is you…

·      Seven or more years of progressive experience in implementing and maintaining Digital Analytics and Tag Management Systems, with a strong preference for Adobe Analytics and experience with Adobe Customer Journey Analytics. Tag Management Systems include Adobe Launch, Tealium iQ, and Google Tag Manager.

·      Four or more years of strong foundational JavaScript experience, with the ability to read, write, and adapt to various coding styles, adapting to client’s existing codebases.

·      Proven experience in debugging analytics implementations using tools like Omnibug, Adobe Experience Cloud Debugger, BrowserStack, etc., and ideally experience with QA monitoring tools.

·      A solid understanding of and experience implementing solutions with user privacy in mind, including consent management frameworks and data minimization principles.

·      Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, quantitative, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to approach technical challenges strategically in the context of data architecture and scalability.

·      Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer


The Opportunity


We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics SaaS company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.


Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3PLs, and carriers.


They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.


The Role


Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.


What You'll Do


  • Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
  • Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
  • Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
  • Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
  • Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
  • Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR



What We're Looking For


Required:


  • 15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
  • Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
  • Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
  • Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
  • Native-level English and executive-level presence
  • Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers


You'll thrive in this role if you:


  • Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
  • Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
  • Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
  • Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain


This is not the right fit if you:

  • Come from a mid-market or non-logistics SaaS background
  • Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
  • Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
  • Have never built or managed a revenue team

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform; ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.


Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.


Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.
  • Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.


Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!
